name: chem-equilibrium-monorepo
description: Chemical equilibrium solver and the equilibrium.cheminfo.org teaching site.

scripts.build: npm run build-lib && npm run build -w equilibrium.cheminfo.org
scripts.check-types: npm run build-lib && npm run check-types -w chem-equilibrium && npm run check-types -w equilibrium.cheminfo.org
scripts.dev: npm run build-lib && npm run dev -w equilibrium.cheminfo.org
scripts.test: npm run test-only && npm run check-types && npm run eslint && npm run prettier
scripts.test-only: npm run test-only -w chem-equilibrium && npm run build-lib && npm run test-only -w equilibrium.cheminfo.org
